findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Facility recently dropped their Quaternary ammonium sanitizer test strips in water. CORRECTED- The inspector provided Quaternary ammonium test strips during the inspection. Ensure that there are always test strips available for every type of sanitizer to make sure that the sanitizer is at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: REPEAT Inspector observed an employee washing their hands in the triple sink. Corrective education was provided for employees. Ensure hands are only washed in the hand sink.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15 Where to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK or APPROVED automatic handwashing facility and may not clean their hands in a sink used for FOOD preparation or WAREWASHING, or in a service sink or a curbed cleaning facility used for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

A food handler was observed to wash hands and then use their bare hand to turn off the faucet, recontaminating the freshly washed hands. Education was conducted about safe hand washing practices to correct. The PIC should ensure that staff is educated about proper hand washing procedures.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands in the three part sink. Education was conducted to correct. Ensure that all hand washing takes place in sinks designated for hand washing.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Brown cardboard boats and paper plates are observed at multiple locations throughout the facility stored with the eating/food contact surfaces facing up. Education was conducted and the boats flipped over to protect the food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips were not available for the in use sanitizers used in the facility at the beginning of the inspection. Test strips were acquired during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Quat sanitizer in the three part sink is observed low on the inspector's test strips. The sink was remade to correct.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: Brown cardboard boat are observed at multiple locations throughout the facility stored with the eating/ food contact surfaces facing up. Education was conducted and the boats flipped over to protect the food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Test strips were not available for the in use sanitizers used in the facility at the beginning of the inspection. Test strips were acquired during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (A) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations not conducted in private home/room with sleeping quarters;  (B) restricted access ; (C) visitors comply with Code; (D) monitor EMPLOYEES' handwashing; (E) monitor deliveries;  (F) approved source/unadulterated;  (G) proper cooking TCS Food; (H) proper cooling ; (I) monitoring temperatures; (J) consumer advisory conveyed; (K) proper sanitizing;  (L) buffets are controlled;  (M) preventing cross-contamination of RTE FOOD with bare hands; (N) EMPLOYEES are properly trained in FOOD; (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of responsibility to report information about health; (P) Written procedures and plans are maintained and implemented as required. Pf  

The dispenser used for quat sanitizing solution is not currently functioning correctly. Follow up for equipment repair/calibration.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. 

No signage is observed during this inspection at the hand sink in the kitchen. Signage given during the inspection to correct. PIC instructed to ensure that signage is maintained for all hand sinks in the food preparation areas.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The bucket of sanitizer observed in the kitchen is between 0-100 ppm quat sanitizer. Both inspector test strips and test strip available at the facility were used to check the concentration. It is believed that the machine used to produce this solution is malfunctioning and EcoLab has already been contacted for maintenance. Tablets have been used to correct the violation for tonight.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

The outside of the pot in the popcorn popper is observed soiled with residual grease/oil. PIC instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation and maintain clean.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

Caulking to the 3-compartment sink is old and frayed, gap between sink and wall. Re-caulk 3-compartment sink to the wall so it is smooth and easily cleanable by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 

Upon inspector arrival a cardboard box holding individually-bagged servings of popcorn was observed sitting on top of handsink. Discussed with staff and PIC. Ensure handsink remains accessible at all times. Store single service equipment in an alternate location, that does not block handwashing or warewashing facilities.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

Observed staff switching between tasks/glove changes without washing hands in between. Discussed with staff and PIC. Ensure staff are washing hands when a change in tasks occurs. For busy moments during games, designating staff to particular tasks may help services run safely and efficiently.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed putting on gloves and handling food without washing hands first. Proper hand washing and glove use was discussed. For pizza, tongs may be used so that no hand contact is occurring. Nachos may be pre-portioned and covered in containers until needed to avoid money handler at rink window from having to wash hands, put on gloves and portion. 

Employees report that they use the first compartment of the three compartment sink for hand washing. A designated hand washing sink is available and this is the sink that must be used. 

2-301.14  (P)  Food employee must practice good hygiene by properly washing hands when changing tasks. Reference 2-301.14.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15  (Pf) Food employee must wash hands at the hand washing sink. Reference 2-301.15.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the coffee maker spout to be soiled black. 

Observed popcorn scoop to be stored on electrical cords. Scoop is reported to usually be stored on a bag in front of popcorn machine. Wash, rinse and sanitize these food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Equipment is not clean to sight and touch. Wash, rinse, sanitize routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed the facility to store some items in cardboard boxes. Discard cardboard when it is empty. Do not use cardboard to store other random items in the facility. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed some non food surfaces to have soil: 1) cap machine in rink 1 2) front of pretzel machine 3) shelves and front of freezer 4) coffee pot nozzle. Clean and maintain free of soil. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed single use coffee filters and stir straws stored unprotected. Clean storage containers and store single use items covered and protected. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed facility to be operating without any sanitizer made. Ensure that during hours of food prep/service that there is sanitizer made and readily available. Sanitizer was made during the inspection. 
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment: 750-100 Observed two pans of cheese and pulled pork stored in the nesquick cooler. Facility has been cooling cheese sauce and pulled pork acccording to employee. Facility is currently permitted under a medium risk permit. Facility shall cease cooling cheese sauce and other potentially hazardous foods. If facility intends to continue this practice, facility must upgrade to a high risk permit. To remain medium risk, facility must cease cooling and reheating products. Inspector will follow up 01/09/17 to determine risk classification. Cheese sauce and pork was discarded to correct the violation.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Observed  a bag of hot dogs stored in the reach in cooler (rockstar cooler) to have an internal temperature of 48 F. Hot dogs were discarded to correct the violation. All potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at the proper temperature at all times during storage 41 F or below or at 135 F or higher.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 750-140(a) Observed the following refrigerated units storing potentially hazardous food to have no thermometers: 1) the nesquick reach in cooler, 2) the rockstar reach in cooler, and 3) the pepsi cooler. All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide thermometers for all units.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-120(a), 750-130(c), 750-130(c) (1) Observed chips and a dipping dots cooler stored under a hole in the ceiling where water lines are exposed. Food shall not be stored under sewer or water lines. Food should be moved and stored away from this area. (2) Observed pans of pulled pork and cheese sauce stored uncovered in the nesquick cooler. Food shall be stored in clean, covered containers. Food shall be protected at all times during storage.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650(a) Observed the door of the popcorn machine to be broken and repaired with duct tape. Duct tape is not a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Repair or replace door of the popcorn machine to be shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-600,750-690 Observed the interior of the dipping dots cooler to have a heavy accumulation of forst/ice build up. Ice is not a cleanable surface. Defrost unit to provide a smooth, easily cleanble surface. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) (1) Observed the bucket and interior walls of the popcorn machine to be soiled with a heavy accumulation of food debris and grease. Clean and maintain all food contact surfaces to prevent cross contamination. Food contact surfaces shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. (2) Observed two pans stored on the island prep area soiled with food debris and grease from the last use. Pans were moved to the three compartment sink to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized to correct the violation. Clean all dishware, cookware, and food equipment after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800(e) Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1) the bottom of the popcorn machine with popcorn and food debris, 2) the counter around the area with food debris and dust, 3) the bottom of the pretzel warmer with food debris, 4) the interior and exterior including the drip tray of the capuccino machine with food debris and food splash, 5) the exterior of the cabinets with food splash, 6) the interior of the cheese dispenser with food debris, 7) the bottom of the rockstar reach in cooler with food debris, and 8) the shelving of the island prep area with food debris and dust. Clean and maintain all non-food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 Observed clean utensils stored in the soiled soap tray above the three compartment sink. Clean utensils shall be stored in a manner that protects the food contact surface from potential contamination.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 (1) Observed single service lids soiled with food splash adjacent to the coffee machine. (2) Observed single service trays for nachos stored with the food contact surface exposed. Single service shall be protected at all times during storage. Single service shall be stored in a manner that protects the food contact surface from potential contamination.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1060 Observed the a leak at the mop sink faucet. Repair faucet. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 Observed the floors throughout the kitchen particularly in not easily reached areas to be soiled with an accumulation of food debris, dust, and random articles. Clean and maintain floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 Observed a hole in the ceiling above the dipping dots cooler. Management states that the hole was made for service work for the facility. All ceilings in food prep and food storage areas shall be smooth and easily cleanable. (2) Observed the ceiling vent over the chest freezer in the kitchen to be soiled with a heavy accumulation of dust. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be cleaned and maintained. (3) Observed the three compartment sink to be separating from the wall. Re-seal sink to the wall to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 (1) Observed a spray bottle of germicide stored next to single service by the capuccino machine. Bottle was removed and stored under the three compartment sink to correct the violation. (2) Observed a spray bottle of germicide stored next to single service and salt for soft pretzels stored in the shelving under the island prep area. Bottle was removed and stored under the three compartment sink to correct the violation.All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a container of hot dogs at Rink 1 that was not labeled with the time and date it was placed in the container.
Label all PHF with time and date that it is removed from the original packaging.
CORRECTED = Container was label.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed that the Rockstar cooler in Rink 1 area did not contain a thermometer.
Provide thermometers for all cooling units.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed that the popcorn machine in the Rink 2 area had a front door of the unit that was broken, and has been repaired with duct tape.
Repair equipment so as to be a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
*Note* Door was broken during the Friday night game. A new replacement door is on order to replace the cracked one.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed that the front of the Cappuccino machine in the Rink 2 area was soiled.
Clean this unit as necessary. 
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed that the inside of two cabinets had not been painted as of yet: 1) the cabinet under the cappuccino machine, and 2) the cabinet under the popcorn maker in Rink 1.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
Paint inside of these cabinets so as to be easily cleanable.
REPEAT violation.
* These two cabinets were the only cabinets missed; all the other cabinets and shelves were painted as cited in the last inspection.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed that the inside of the microwave oven in the Rink 1 area, and the top inside of the popcorn maker in the pool concession were soiled. 
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
Clean these surfaces.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed a box of cup lids stored on the floor in the pool concession area.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
Store single-service items properly.
CORRECTED= lids were placed on shelf.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
The roller grill in rinks 1 & 2 were missing their covers.  There is a cover for one, however, so put it back on the grill and obtain a cover for the other grill.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)

750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1.   Pool concession - The white chest freezer in the room outside the concession room has a build-up of frost in it.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)   Defrost the freezer.
2.   Rink 1 - The drawer below the cappuccino machine has a missing handle.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Replace the handle.
3.   Rink 1 - The inside of the lower cabinets have raw wood in them.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Paint the inside of the cabinets with a light colored glossy paint so they re smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.
4.   Rink 1 - The counter to wall junctions are forming gaps.  Clean out the old caulk and re-seal them.  ((REPEAT VIOLATION)

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1.   Pool concession - The inside of the pizza oven was soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)   Clean and sanitize it.
2.   Pool concession - The top inside of the popcorn popper was soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean and sanitize it.
3.   Pool concession - The inside of the microwave oven was soiled.  Clean and sanitize it.
4.   Rink 2 - The water nozzle area (above the grounds basket) was soiled.  Clean and sanitize this area.

750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1.  Rink 2 - The window sills were soiled.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Clean the sills.
2.  Rink 2 - The inside of some lower cabinets were soiled with spills.  Clean the inside of the cabinets.
3.  Rink 2 - The base on the white portable heater was soiled.  Clean the base.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Coffee filters were stored on the coffee maker unprotected.  Store the filters in a closed container or in the bag they came in and keep the bags closed..

750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
1.   Rink 1 - The faucet on the 3-pan sink leaks. (REPEAT VIOLATION)   Repair the faucet.
2.   Rink 1 - The drain under the 3-pan sink had mold in it.  Clean the drain.
3.   Rink 2 - The hand sink is slow to drain.  Unclog the sink.   (NOTE:  Do not put anything in the sink other than hands - no food, drinks, ice, etc.)
4.   Men's bathroom near rink 2 - There is very little water pressure at the hand sink hot water faucets.  Repair the plumbing to provide more water pressure.
5.   All restrooms - Several faucets will not stay on for 15 seconds.  Repair or replace the faucets so they will stay on a minimum of 15 seconds.


750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Pool concession - There were no paper towels in the dispenser at the hand sink .  Put towels in the dispenser.

750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1.   Rink 1 - There is foam sealant around the plumbing lines where they go into the wall.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)  Shave off the excess sealant and smooth the areas over.  Possibly paint it if the foam can be painted.
2.   Restroom near rink 2 (women's) - The ceiling vent is soiled.  Clean the vent.
3.   Restroom near rink 2 (men's and women's) - There are gaps between the vanity backsplash and wall and around the sinks where they are set in the vanity tops.  Re-caulk the backsplashs to the walls and around the sinks.  
4.   Restrooms by lockers on main floor - There are gaps between the vanity backsplash and wall and around the sinks where they are set in the vanity tops.  Re-caulk the backsplashs to the walls and around the sinks.  
5.   Restrooms by lockers on main floor (men's) - There is a gap between the urinal and wall.  Seal the gap.
6.   Some bathrooms and concession stands have acoustic tiles in the ceilings.  On or before the next remodel of the facilities, replace the acoustic tiles with ones that are smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.

750-1210a Walls and ceilings shall be smooth, durable, non-absorbent, and maintained in good repair.
750.1220a Walls and ceilings shall be kept free of accumulated soil, build-up.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Hotdog roller in pool concession stand did not have a cover. A cover was observed in the control room next to Rink 1 concession stand. Clean/sanitize the cover and place it on the hotdog roller in the pool concession stand. Obtain enough covers so all hotdog rollers have a proper cover.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - RINK 1 A) White chest freezer with pizzas has frost buildup. Defrost the freezer. B) Drawer below cappuccino machine does not have a handle. Replace the missing handle. C) One drawer is lined with paper. Removed the paper from the drawer. D) Cabinet labeled coffee/cappuccino has rough wood inside. Paint the cabinet so it is smooth and easily cleanable.
Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled (all items observed in pool concession area): A) top inside popcorn machine; B) hotdog roller; C) pizza oven; D) relish tray; E) hotdog tongs; & F) floor fans. Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. **Up to every 4 hours clean and sanitize utensils or replace soiled utensils with clean utensils (i.e. tongs).**

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) cabinets & drawers in all concession stands (some observed to have dead roaches inside in Rink 1 main concession area); B) inside Pepsi coolers throughout facilities (dust/debris on dividers and dead bugs in tracks of cooler in Rink 2); & C) window sill in Rink 2 (dead bugs & dust). Clean all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - A microwave, pizza oven, and hotdog roller were observed on the floor in Rink 1 concession stand. Store clean equipment and all food related items at least 6 inches off the floor. Cleaned and sanitized utensils and equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text: 750.1060 - A) Leak was observed at 3 part sink faucet in Rink 1 main concession stand. B) Water pressure fluctuated at men's room faucets in Rink 2 - management thought it could be due to water use for zambonee. C) Hot water temporarily not available at restrooms in Rink 1 due to boiler being replaced (see general comments). Have a licensed plumber make necessary repairs. Provide an adequate water supply for restrooms in Rink 2 so the pressure is not affected by water usage in other areas. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor in Rink 1 main concession stand was soiled with debris (behind chemical cabinet and at corner under south order window) and dead roaches. Clean the floor in Rink 1 main concession stand.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 - A) Ceiling tiles in restrooms throughout facilities are acoustic. Replace with smooth, cleanable tiles at next remodel. RINK 1 B) (R) Shelving is pulling apart below order windows in main concession stand and crevices are soiled with debris. Clean out the crevices and repair the shelves. C) Multiple holes were observed in the wall above the 3 part sink and handsink in main concession stand. Foam spray was observed around plumbing, and the 3 part sink is pulling away from the wall. Properly seal the holes and gaps. Smooth out the foam insulation and re-seal the 3 part sink to the wall. RINK 2 D) Duct tape used at counter/wall/window joint. Remove duct tape and properly seal with caulk.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.citation_text: 750.1310 - Bottle of bleach was observed on top of single use gloves in pool concession area. Other chemicals were also observed next to the box of gloves. Two jugs used to fill slushie machine with water were observed sitting on the same shelf. Box of gloves were discarded, and jugs were moved to a different location away from chemicals. All toxic items must be properly stored segregated from food and all food related items (i.e. single use gloves, clean equipment, etc.) to reduce the potential for cross contamination. Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text: 750.1350 - One of the fridges in Rink 2 does not work and is not going to be used. Properly dispose of the fridge. Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Hotdogs on rotisserie in pool concession stand were 116F (surface temp) - 124F (internal temp). Hot foods must be held at 135F/above at all times unless time is being used as a control. Management discarded the hotdogs in the trash during the inspection.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text: 750.160 - (R) Styrofoam cups were observed inside plastic tubs of popping corn in Rink 2 and in the pool concession stand. Replace cups with scoops that have handles. Use only scoops with handles for dispensing foods. **Whatever is on the hands of the employees dispensing the popping corn will get on the edge of the cups where they touch and potentially get in the popping corn. Just because popping corn is heated does not mean all microorganisms (i.e. viruses) will be destroyed. Always use scoops with handles and store scoops with handles extended up out of products.**

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text: 750.290  - Rink 1: food contact surface of ice scoop on top of ice machine was touching cardboard box and plastic bags. at Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice. Ice scoop was moved on top of inverted plastic lid where it is normally stored. **Clean and sanitize the ice scoop with other utensils daily/as needed**

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750.650a - Rink 2 - A) Right side door of popcorn machine was broken off/lying on counter. Piece of duct tape was observed on the hinge. Properly repair or replace the popcorn machine door. B) Yellow plastic lid to popping corn storage tub in the cabinet was cracked. Replace the cracked lid. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) Rink 1: 1) (R) inside microwave, 2) pizza oven, 3) detachable pieces of cappuccino machine, 4) (R) upstairs kitchenette - inside microwave, & 5) ice scoop on top of ice machine (see #10) & B) Rink 2: 1) detachable pieces of cappuccino machine, 2) top inside popcorn machine, 3) drawer holding clean utensils, & 4) tongs on top of chip storage tub. Properly clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of food and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) (R) inside all cappuccino machines; B) Rink 2: 1) inside cheese dispenser, 2) cabinets above sinks, & 3) window sill (dead bugs); & C) Rink 1: drawers/cabinets by cappuccino machine (dried chocolate buildup). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Clean utensils were observed in drawer that was soiled in Rink 2 concession stand. Cleaned and sanitized utensils and equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Keep storage drawers and cabinets clean.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - Rink 2: (R) Plastic knives were observed in Styrofoam cups with the food surfaces extended up out of the cups. Store all utensils with food surfaces down and handles up out of storage containers to protect food surfaces from potential contamination. **People serving food should only touch handles of utensils.**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floors were observed to be soiled in the following areas: A) Rink 1: 1) under ice machine and blue storage shelves, & 2) in crevice along floor where shelves have pulled away under order window counter at concession stand; & B) Rink 2: (R) under two door cooler. Clean the floors in the above areas. Clean underneath all equipment and shelves nightly/as needed.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) Acoustic ceiling tiles were observed in all restrooms except downstairs in Rink 1. Replace all acoustic ceiling tiles with ones that are smooth and cleanable in restrooms and any concession areas that  have acoustic tiles (i.e. Rink 2) at the next remodel. B) Shelving has pulled away from the wall under order window counter at concession stand. After floor is cleaned repair the shelves/seal the area in question. C) Ceiling vent cover in Rink 1 upstairs women's room was dusty. Clean the vent cover. D) Cover was missing from air conditioner in Rink 2 stand and area was dusty. Clean AC unit and replace missing cover.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.citation_text: 750.160 - Styrofoam cups were observed inside plastic tubs of popping corn. Replace cups with scoops that have handles. Use only scoops with handles for dispensing foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) Rink 1: 1) inside microwave; 2) inside popcorn machine; & 3) coffee spout; B) Rink 2: hotdog rotisserie; C) Pool: inside popcorn machine; & D) SRA kitchen: inside microwaves. Wash, rinse, & sanitize the above items and all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled in all concession areas: A) shelves; B) inside/outside of cabinets & drawers; C) inside cappuccino machines; & D) inside coolers & freezers. Clean the above items. Make sure inside/outside of all coolers and freezers are cleaned regularly, including the racks in soda coolers.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - A) Rink 2: Plastic knives were observed in Styrofoam cups with the food surfaces extended up out of the cups. Store all utensils with food surfaces down and handles up out of storage containers to protect food surfaces from potential contamination. **People serving food should only touch handles of utensils.** B) Rink 1: Box of insulated cups were observed on the floor in the storage area. Store single use items elevated at least 6 inches off the floor. **Always store food, single use items, and all food related items off the floor**

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1110d & 1120e - A) Restrooms in Rink 2 and Rink 1 (upstairs) did not have covered  waste cans. Provide covers for the current waste cans or replace with receptacles that have lids. B) Paper towels were not available at the handsink in the pool snack shop. Paper towels were placed in the dispenser. Also, soap was not available in the women's room (Rink 1 by skating rink entrance)**Always maintain a supply of soap and paper towels at all handsinks.**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floors were observed to be soiled in the following areas: 1) Rink 1: under coolers and drawer/cabinet (next to handsink) & 2) Rink 2: under two door cooler. Clean the floors in the above areas. Clean underneath all equipment and shelves nightly/as needed. B) Rink 1: Old floor drain under two door Pepsi cooler does not have a cover. Employees were unsure as to where the drain goes (may be sealed off). Provide a cover for the drain until it can be determined for sure if the line is sealed.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.citation_text: 750.1390 & 1160 A) Damp mop head was observed stored down in a mop bucket (janitor's closet in Rink 2). Store mops hanging or inverted between uses to allow for proper drying. Wet mop heads can serve as a potential food & water source for pests. B) Standing water was observed under the handsink at the Rink 1 snack shop and by the white standup freezer in the storage area. Minimize standing water to eliminate water sources for potential pests. **Employees should clean up spills/report plumbing issues as they occur.**
